reviews.author: Graham W.
reviews.text:
We were pleasantly surprised by the 1 room camping cabin. As two adults who spent most daylight hours at others' campsites, it worked out nicely for sleep and storage.

The sleeping pads are more comfortable than they look, I didn't feel the need for any extra padding. In addition to bed linens, I would recommend also bringing your own curtains, as the supplied ones don't do much to block the morning light.

reviews.author: Jessi C.
reviews.text: This KOA is amazing! We experienced such friendly staff.  They continuously were busy around the campground,  making sure it was clean,  safe and making sure everything was running smoothly... and they always had a big smile on their faces and would wave greeting us everytime. The campground was really clean and the location is impeccable,  with the ocean being just a short walk across the street.  It's also close to several towns for supplies (although the store is fully stocked with anything you'd need as well) and so many beautiful trails.  We stayed in a cabin with 4 people. It was the perfect size,  very clean and nicely upkept,  and fully stocked.  We have older kids, and we still enjoyed the activities as a family,  with mini golf,  beanbags,  the pool/ hot tub and campfires! We highly recommend this location and we will be back!

reviews.author: Alex
reviews.text: We had an amazing stay at Warrenton / Seaside KOA Resort! Everything was great, clean, comfortable, and very family friendly. The staff was kind and helpful, and the atmosphere was wonderful. We enjoyed it so much that this is already our second time staying here, and we definitely want to come back again. Thank you for such a great experience!

reviews.author: Caitlin J.
reviews.text: This is the best campground! We have 7 and 9 year old kids and they were in heaven. The facility is top notch, super clean and you never run out of things to do with all the activities and ft Steven’s being right across the street. The staff are all extremely friendly and seem to love their jobs. We cannot wait to return! Take a bike ride through ft Steven’s to the shipwreck, you won’t be disappointed!

reviews.author: Korey
reviews.text: We booked a Kabin, which was clean but needs to be updated with some modern amenities (coffee maker, TV, complimentary items, etc.) and not rely totally on the location. We have stayed in many KOA locations, including one recently at Klamath Falls which was excellent, and this was on the lower end. Initially the service was great as we received an early check in notice text, but we could not reach a live person on the phone after making several attempts, although text messaging with another individual seemed to work fine.  This was not a concern when notifying the individual through text. Location is excellent for those wanting to visit nearby Astoria or the Lewis and Clark National Historical Park.
